name: program-runtime.watch-set
purpose: Start up to eight delegated Agent Manager runs from a request list, collect each once, classify the collected outputs with one governed batch call, and summarize by label.

requests.description: List of {owner, workflow_key, input}; each becomes one agent.start. Default: one skill-experiment-audit smoke request.

labels.description: Closed label set for the outcome classification.

wait_seconds.description: Wait per collect; capped at 300 by the bridge.

assumptions: each workflow_key names a workflow its owner declares; an unknown key is a typed failure (workflow_rejected), not a silent no-op
the session carries a delegated-run spend ceiling; reaching it is a refusal (delegated_run_spend_exceeded), not a retry
ai.classify(texts=..., labels=...) returns one row per text shaped {label, text} (kernel/host/engine.py _resolve_labels_schema and _classify_batch)
invariants: each run is collected exactly once; no polling loop
no retry: a failed start stops the program with its class
the envelope is printed exactly once, on every path

signals.collected: count of runs that returned an output
signals.runs: list of {index, label, validated} per collected run

budget.async_reason: wall_ms exceeds the 120 s synchronous submission bound; submit with --async and wait once

fixtures.note: Expects the status the program should produce. On 2026-09-02 the delegation bridge is broken: agent.start returned NOT_FOUND_WORKFLOWREVISION for development-toolchain-validator/skill-experiment-audit (the smoke workflow is no longer declared) and, before that, schema_mismatch on the workflow input; the live run therefore ends failed/workflow_rejected until the bridge route lands (program-runtime-improve §5 delegation-live). A fixture never pins that broken outcome.
